thread:
Priya Shah: short sync for NimbusCorp POC. Scope: doc search + two tool calls (create_invoice, approve_payment). They want SOW, success metrics, model guidance (context), and a committed price example for ~10k q/day. Deadline: demo in 9 business days.

Liam O'Malley: propose compact success metrics: precision@5 >= 0.80 on their labeled set; E2E tool-call success >= 95% (schema + side-effect check); search p95 < 500ms; token cost per query <= $0.0035 (hosted). Add PII redaction and audit logs.

Zoe Park: model fit: recommend testing 32k-context family because contracts are long. If cost/latency too high, fallback to 16k or chunked 8k. Pipeline: embeddings (ANN) -> lightweight reranker (prompt first) -> generator for tool payloads. Quantized reranker if needed.

Priya Shah: timeline: Day0-2 ingest & sample prompts (need 40 labeled prompts), Day3-5 embeddings + index, Day6-7 reranker & prompts, Day8 tool integration + E2E smoke, Day9 demo + acceptance.

Liam O'Malley: embeddings sizing estimate: ~200k docs, avg 3KB -> ~600M tokens. Start with 768d embeddings; if recall low try 1024d. Recommend nightly incremental refresh; webhook triggers for urgent docs.

FinanceBot: requested: example calc for 10k q/day -> ~300k q/mo. Provide hosted vs reserved lines; finance to confirm committed discounts.

Priya Shah: security asks to capture in SOW: SAML SSO+SCIM, BYOK/KMS, 12mo audit log retention, completed security questionnaire. NimbusCorp to return questionnaire within 48h.

Zoe Park: quick sample curl for POC engineer:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/semsearch \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"query":"How do I dispute an invoice?","top_k":50,"rerank":true,"model":"rwd-32k-search"}'
```

InfraBot: ticket NIMBUS-POC-2125054321 created, infra ticket INF-9007 opened, service account provisioned, KMS pending customer auth.

Priya Shah: blockers to surface on customer call: 1) security questionnaire, 2) finance commit approval, 3) customer-provided prompts & SSO creds, 4) validate 32k latency on sample docs. Next sync Thu 10am PT.
